mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, conversation_id, message_id, step_index, note, created_at FROM debug_breakpoint WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY message_id ASC, step_index ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO debug_breakpoint (user_id, conversation_id, message_id, step_index, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{stepIndex}, #{note})
